searchText: <@427491045308235776> i want to bring your attention to [keccak-f](https://github.com/eth-act/zkevm-standards/pull/26) again. i'm having a hard time understanding why such a small proposal has been sitting unresolved for over 4 (!) months. now we'd like to develop guests for zkvms other than zisk, and this is becoming a blocker for us because we currently rely on a non-standard zisk api. i recall that online hashing was mentioned during the last breakout, but i don't have much context on it, and i'm not sure when it’s expected to land. the same applies to [logging](https://github.com/eth-act/zkevm-standards/pull/27) as well. thanks Next L1-zkEVM breakout call is Wed, September 09 at 15:00 UTC https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2215
